topic: What payload modifications are needed to handle concurrent multi-user access using cyclic-shifted ZC sequences without interference?
response: To handle concurrent multi-user access using cyclic-shifted ZC sequences without interference, the payload modifications needed are: (1) selecting root indexes and cyclic shift offsets to avoid coincident peak time indexes, and (2) ensuring fractional delay differences between users do not result in mutual coincidence within the detection window. This can be achieved by choosing co-prime cyclic shift offsets or using techniques like successive interference cancellation.
